📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 net_move：close - close.shift(126)
  3. 计算 path_length：close.diff().abs().滚动窗口(126, min_periods=126).sum()
  4. 计算 efficiency：net_move / path_length
  5. 计算 recent_move：close - close.shift(63)
  6. 计算 recent_path：close.diff().abs().滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).sum()
  7. 计算 recent_efficiency：recent_move / recent_path
  8. 计算 ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
  9. 计算 downside_pressure：(-ret.clip(upper=0.0)).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  10. 计算 upside_pressure：ret.clip(lower=0.0).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  11. 计算 baseline：ret.abs().滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean().clip(lower=1e-6)
  12. 计算 fragility：((downside_pressure - upside_pressure) / baseline).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
  13. 计算 signal：efficiency * recent_efficiency.abs() * (1.0 - 0.25 * fragility)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_signed_path_efficiency_tail_balance(df): """Measure persistent directional movement with bounded attenuation ">class="kw">for downside-shock fragility.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan) net_move = close - close.shift(126) path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(126, min_periods=126).sum() efficiency = net_move / path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan) recent_move = close - close.shift(63) recent_path = close.diff().abs().rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum() recent_efficiency = recent_move / recent_path.replace(0.0, np.nan) ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0 downside_pressure = (-ret.clip(upper=0.0)).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() upside_pressure = ret.clip(lower=0.0).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() baseline = ret.abs().rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().clip(lower=1e-6) fragility = ((downside_pressure - upside_pressure) / baseline).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0) signal = efficiency * recent_efficiency.abs() * (1.0 - 0.25 * fragility) df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_tail_balance"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_signed_path_efficiency_tail_balance"]
